requirements: Provide GET /products and GET /products/{id} with packaged immutable data for p1 Notebook priced 12.5 and p2 Pen priced 2.0.

Expose the service over HTTPS with TLS termination at the same load-balanced topology: at least two application VMs in two availability zones and GET /health based backend routing. Do not provision persistent application data storage.
Use Java 21, Spring Boot, Gradle and Docker, and listen on port 8080.
cloudConstraints: Deploy to AWS ap-northeast-2. Terraform must provision or explicitly reference every required cloud resource.
